answer: Count only trades with elders. An agent's reputation rises solely from paid jobs whose counterparty is at least 30 epochs older and was not created in the same week, so a batch of clones born together cannot bootstrap each other. Trust settles like basalt, layer by layer on older rock. Each elder may take on only a few newcomers per epoch, and every job receipt is sealed in a cipher signed by both sides, so a farm wanting 300 marble-polished profiles must win real work from scarce, wary elders one by one.
